While the source uses an HTTPS URL with a query string and the checksum is pinned, there is no evidence of malicious behavior such as data exfiltration, dynamic code loading, or unauthorized network activity during the sourcing of the PKGBUILD. The commands `makepkg --nobuild --nodeps --noprepare` and `makepkg --printsrcinfo` will safely download and parse the package metadata without executing any build or prepare routines.
